plain: Menus, popovers, select listboxes, toasts and dialogs are now white in light and draw a 1px border.default hairline so they separate from muted surfaces; no code change needed.

steps.plain: --role-popover (bg-popover) now reads the new semantic.color.surface.floating (white light, neutral.800 dark) instead of surface.overlay; if you set this variable, check your overlays still separate from surface.muted.
--semantic-elevation-overlay-border is now border.default, not transparent; a surface that binds the overlay elevation bundle should draw it as a 1px border.
--semantic-elevation-overlay-surface is now surface.floating (white light, neutral.800 dark); a surface that binds it turns white in light.
